title: Choose the visual world
question: The blue dashboard is the category default. The roll assigned Fare accepted. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Fare accepted
options.lineage: a transit fare validator the moment a trip locks
options.thesis: Home is one accepted fare: the month's net, then the line you just spoke, then nothing else at that size.
options.viewport: Native tabs. An ink shell carries a monumental net. The phrase sits in that shell and snaps in place to Uber, Transport, $4.500, with one Accept. The page ground is the shell's own dust. Category rows below wear full color ribbons.
options.risk: If the number is only a little larger than today, it is the same hat-on-grey screen in brown.

raised.raise: Each category row wears its color as a ribbon, not a dot.
The net is the only display-scale figure on the screen.
The page ground is a light of the shell, one climate, not a colored hat on grey.
Income and out stay in the caption. No second number competes with the net.

options.label: Spoken price
options.lineage: a market price called out as one line
options.thesis: Home is the sentence you just said. The balance is the consequence, not the hero.
options.viewport: Native tabs. The phrase field leads at display size. As it parses, the same line becomes Uber, Transport, $4.500. The month net sits under it, quieter.
options.risk: This is where most expense apps land: a big field under a balance, only cleaner.

options.label: Price mosaic
options.thesis: The month is a packed board of ruled modules. The phrase is one module that resolves in place.
options.viewport: Native tabs over a tight mosaic: net, phrase, budgets, and the week sentence visible together, each in its own ruled cell.
options.case: People already scan prices this densely. The phone's type floor and 44pt targets lose the pack.
options.risk: Tiny type makes a finance app illegible.

options.label: Ticket wallet
options.thesis: Each spend stays visible as a leg. Deleting it stamps VOID. Nothing vanishes.
options.viewport: Native tabs. The month is the wallet cover. Activity is one leg per row, carbon figures, a red VOID on delete.
options.case: A kept ticket is a familiar proof of a spend. A perforation or tear-off would hide the task.
options.risk: The row grows a fake ticket edge and stops reading as a list.

options.label: Character roster
options.thesis: Categories as a cast of mascots.
options.viewport: A roster of characters standing in for categories.
options.case: A person logging a fare does not see themselves in a mascot grid, and the amounts disappear behind the cast.
options.kept: Each category wears its color as a ribbon, not a dot.

options.label: Grid specimen
options.thesis: The balance built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: A visible grid with the net assembled from its cells.
options.case: Checking money is not reading a type specimen, and a visible grid does not help the task.
options.kept: The net is monumental. It is the only display-scale figure.
options.risk: The screen reads as a poster of a number.

options.label: Tabbed manual
options.thesis: Each tab is a full-strength colored board under a clear leaf.
options.viewport: Four colored boards, one per tab, with the reading field floating above.
options.case: A manual is not how this money gets logged, and a colored board per tab fights one tint.
options.kept: The page ground is a light of the shell, one climate.
options.risk: Four loud boards, one app that never settles.

options.label: Emission rail
options.lineage: a glass spectrogram on a viewing box
options.thesis: Every state is a line's height and dash. Color is only a hairline.
options.viewport: One rail. The open screen blooms above a tick. State is dash, not hue.
options.case: This is an instrument costume. Money in, money out, and the 80 percent warning need color, not only line form.
options.kept: One figure outranks every other size. Nothing else is allowed to be large.
options.risk: A lab instrument standing in for a ledger.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Revolut or Copilot screen, played straight: one tint, a large balance, a list, a donut.
canonCard.viewport: Native tabs, a tinted balance band, a phrase card, category split, budget warnings.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the screen that already feels monotonous.
